about_the_game:
EXTRA! EXTRA! Command a hacker crew in a gripping 4X rogue-lite. Plunge into mechanical networks, employing real cyber-skulduggery tactics. Roll the dice for new daring operatives, seize control of systems and exfiltrate resources. Time's a-tickin'! Coppers are tailing you! Regroup, then hit the wires again!

Join the infiltrators as the head honcho hacker and find dozens more to join the breach.

• Roguelite 20-40 min runs combined with 4X complexity.

• Stories inspired by real cyber-security scenarios. 

• Retro-futuristic alternative future where devices retained their analog charm.

• Navigate a complex network system. 

• Use real intrusion practices. 

• Encounter various events. 

• Find and then confirm clues to progress. 

• Use your team's strengths and weaknesses. 

• Evolve your team's abilities. 

• Gather resources to increase hacking power. 

• Balance speed and threat level to succeed.

• Return to central hub after each run. 

• Talk to the characters and find their secrets. 

• Inspect clues you gathered and pick where to go next. 

• Buy tools to aid you on your next mission. 

• Chose infiltration policies.

• Enjoy heavy jazz jamming out in the background.

content_descriptors.notes: The game explores themes of crime, violence and drug use.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 Home 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-2120 / AMD® FX 6350
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce™ GTX 660 (2GB) / AMD® Radeon™ HD 7870 (2GB) / Intel® Iris Pro™ 580 / Intel® Iris® Plus G7 / AMD® Radeon™ Vega 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 Home 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4670K / AMD® Ryzen™ 5 2400G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce™ GTX 1650 (4GB) / AMD® Radeon™ R9 390X (8GB)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
